records.question: Davante has twice as many friends as there are days in the week. 3 of his friends are girls. How many friends does he have that are boys?
records.response:
Davante has 7 days in the week.
Twice as many friends as there are days in the week means he has 2*7=14 friends.
3 of his friends are girls, so he has 14-3=11 friends that are boys.
